rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>A land erased from history, huh... Why were the brass hiding the information?
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Keeping the accident secret for over 10 years and never disposing of it in all that time... I don't get that either.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>...Perhaps it wasn't disposed of because it was dangerous.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Dangerous?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>For example, it might actually still be running even now.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Seriously?!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>It's only a possibility.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, what's wrong?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I don't know... I can't seem to settle down.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I know you still haven't accepted all this.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>But... with the situation being what it is, I need you to cooperate for now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>No, it's not that... I've got a strange, uneasy feeling.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>...?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Ugh...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>?!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I'm fine... I only got a little dizzy. Sorry.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>...Don't worry about it. You're my partner, after all.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Partner... huh.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>This may turn out to be a dangerous operation.
rows.notes: Source has a typo (dropped kana) but meaning is clear.

rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I sense an unpleasant pressure from this place. It won't go easily.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>But...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>It's all right, I won't tell the others. It would only make them needlessly anxious.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Still, getting shoved left and right by a single scrap of paper... Give me a break.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>7 violations of orders, 5 disciplinary confinements, 6 removals as flight leader... That's some record, Lt. <color(4)>Dyson<ce()>.
rows.notes: Rank outside the color span, as in source. 'That's some record' avoids the q glyph.

rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>That's our Captain for you. You sure do hear things fast...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Transfer to <color(4)>Londo Bell<ce()> following the cancellation of Project Super Nova...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Commander <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> valued your skill and went out of his way for you. Otherwise...
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>I'd be doing repair rounds on eco-satellites and clearing debris, ma'am?
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>I'm grateful for the kindness, so I won't complain for now. ...Someday, I'll settle things once and for all.

uncertainties.issue: 'it' (the thing not disposed of) is unnamed in the source; kept as 'it'. Probably the facility/site of the accident - check against the mission briefing.
Ruri's 'But...' - she seems to worry about telling the others; Amuro's reply settles it.
'Captain' = Ruri (captain of Nadesico B) addressed mock-respectfully by Isamu; inferred from previous row's speaker.
'eco-satellites' is a literal rendering of 'eko eisei'; no glossary entry and not a term I could tie to Macross Plus. Isamu uses mock-formal military speech toward Faye -> 'ma'am'.
What Isamu will 'settle' is unstated (cancelled project / rivalry with Guld?); kept vague.

checked_decisions: 0/20-21 'it' (the undisposed thing) left unnamed as in source. Accepted; cannot verify referent without the briefing.
1/61 Ruri's 'But...': Amuro's reply (won't tell the others) settles it. Accepted.
1/101 'Captain' = Ruri (kanchou-dono, reply to Ruri's row). Accepted; note that Amuro's taii is also 'Captain' in this corpus - unavoidable collision.

1/104 'ma'am': mock-formal '-de arimasu ka' reply to speaker 1060 (Faye, female per glossary). Ruri is also female, so 'ma'am' is safe whichever woman is the addressee. 'eco-satellites' literal, no glossary entry. Accepted.
1/103 'his' for Misumaru: glossary meeting_terms_015 gives gender male. 'Project Super Nova' and 'Londo Bell' match glossary.
1/105 object of 'settle things' unstated in source; kept vague. Accepted.
remaining_uncertainties: 0/20-21: referent of 'it' (what was not disposed of) not verified against the mission briefing.

1/102-103: the source assigns these polite, well-informed lines about Isamu's transfer to speaker 1060 (Faye), though they read like Ruri continuing from 1/100. Translated as the data says; addressee of Isamu's 'ma'am' in 1/104 is therefore Faye by data, possibly Ruri by intent - harmless either way.
